name: Cyclothon
gathering: The city at cycling speed. Slow enough to smell it, which is the argument.

holes.what: How many Cyclothons have run. Two are on record, in 2012 and in 2014–15, and whether there were others between or since is not written down anywhere we hold.
holes.unlocks: A count of editions and the year of the last one. The rides themselves are described — the route, the turnout, the cycles lent to people who had none — but a figure on this page needs a dated record behind it and there is none.
